slide_intent: Show the effect of progress with comparable quantities so viewers can see what changed.

demonstration: A three-part stage display presents punctuality, a total score and renewable-electricity change beside a written explanation of progress messaging.
practical_value: Pair a change figure with its underlying measure and emphasize the consequence for people.
